en: Black‑and‑white view of a large, plain Baroque‑style manor house or small palace with a steep tiled roof featuring multiple small "eye" dormer windows. In front is a formal vegetable and flower garden bordered by low stone walls and hedges. A dirt lane runs alongside the garden, where several children in early 20th‑century clothing stand, one pushing a baby carriage, while a horse‑drawn carriage with two horses approaches from the distance. On the left edge another building with similar plastered walls and multi‑pane windows is visible, with a person looking out. The overall scene is rural, calm, and somewhat staged, typical of early photographic postcards.
